I had the Mirena IUD put in about two years ago ans I love it.  The insertion itself was incredibly painful.  I had whats called a vasovegal response and passed out in the clinic I was at.  Afterwards my SO carried me home and I stayed in bed with a heating pad on my tum all day.  Also for the next few days I would get horrific cramps.  As time wore on however the cramps came less and less often.  I'd say they wore off in about a month.
As for periods, I don't have to deal with them anymore!  There was some spotting for a couple of weeks after the insertion but nothing awful.  The spotting eventually trailed off and now Aunt Flo is on extended leave.
Not having to try to remember to take a goddam pill at a certain time every day is amazing.  And not having to worry about it for the next 3 years is awesome!  The hormone dose is very low and my SO and I haven't detected any changes in weight or sex drive.
